# sustain_client (Resource)

A client: a company in the organisation's directory at Link, with its services and its status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A company in the organisation's directory at Link, by Link's id. Enterprise's.
resource "sustain_client" "hooli" {
  company_id    = "cmp_33333333333333333333333333333333"
  support_hours = { days = ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri"], start_time = "09:00", end_time = "17:30", time_zone = "Europe/London" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `company` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--company))
- `company_id` (String) Its company at Link, by Link's id; null once Link erased it.
- `contract` (Attributes) A client's contract, or a service's own: what its availability is held to in its reports, and how it's reckoned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contract))
- `support_hours` (Attributes) A client's support hours: on these days, from and to these times of day, by a time zone's clocks, within the day. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--support_hours))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8601 time in UTC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--company"></a>
### Nested Schema for `company`

Required:

- `display_name` (String)

Optional:

- `domain` (String)
- `website` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--contract"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contract`

Required:

- `maintenance` (String) Whether maintenance is left out of its time, or counted as downtime.

Optional:

- `hours` (Attributes) A client's support hours: on these days, from and to these times of day, by a time zone's clocks, within the day. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contract--hours))
- `target_percent` (Number) The availability it promises, a percentage above 0 and up to 100, such as 99.9; null for none.

<a id="nestedatt--contract--hours"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contract.hours`

Required:

- `days` (List of String) In the week's order, once each.
- `end_time` (String) When they end, after they begin, on the same day: "24:00" at the latest.
- `start_time` (String) When they begin, as "09:00".
- `time_zone` (String) The IANA time zone whose clocks they keep, as Europe/London.



<a id="nestedatt--support_hours"></a>
### Nested Schema for `support_hours`

Required:

- `days` (List of String) In the week's order, once each.
- `end_time` (String) When they end, after they begin, on the same day: "24:00" at the latest.
- `start_time` (String) When they begin, as "09:00".
- `time_zone` (String) The IANA time zone whose clocks they keep, as Europe/London.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id in Sustain, as its page in the console, or its API, gives it.
terraform import sustain_client.hooli <id>
```
